title: Thirty Years and One Closed Gate
subtitle: 时间与年代 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 时间与年代（历史社会与文化·时间与年代）
meta: 主题语境：时间与年代（历史社会与文化·时间与年代）　|　核心词汇：decade　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decade 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 the archivist ① counted a decade that no historian in the province would have named, and he said the counting was the whole of the catalogue. The ② decade, meaning the ten years and not the period, ran to thirty years and stayed unshelved; a decade, he said, is the only thing in an archive that is judged by how long it is left unlabelled.

Every ③ decade in that archive had the same closed gate at the end of it, and the ④ decade at the end, meaning the one they kept for the photographs and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened twice. A decade, his assistant said, is nine parts sorting and one part somebody willing to count; the archivist said the sorting is the part that fills thirty years.

The curator meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the decade was the whole of the exhibition, meaning the period and not the ten years. The ⑥ decade, meaning the period and not any of that, is the only thing in an exhibition that everybody dates and nobody defines; decade, she said, is either something you count or the only word that means both ten years and a period. She said the period is the part they remember.

By 1955 the ⑦ decade had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the closed gate. The ⑧ decade of the whole thing, the archivist wrote in April, was one archive and thirty years of sorting; decade, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sort. She said the sorting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ decade I remember is the one at the end, which was catalogued in 1981 and is still described as the fullest in the province. A ⑩ decade, the assistant said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being counted; every decade, she said, is a period that has agreed to look like ten years. She said the period was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 十年；十年期（指档案里归档的那一整段）
B. n. 十年（指那十年本身，与那个时代相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a decade 清点一个十年期
D. n. 十年（指留给照片专档的那一段）
E. n. 十载；年代（抽象总称，指一座档案馆里的全部编年）
F. n. 年代（指导览手册上写到、被标明的那一段）
G. n. 时代；年代（指展览里断代的那一段时期）
H. n. 时代（抽象总称，指人人断代却无人定义的那一段）

items.q: counted a decade that no historian in the province would have named
The decade, meaning the ten years and not the period
the decade was the whole of the exhibition
the decade had become a line in a guidebook
The decade of the whole thing
A decade, the assistant said in 1983

answers.why: count a decade 意为“清点一个十年期”，1946 年档案员清点了一个全省没有一位史家肯命名的十年期。
decade 意为“十年”，指那十年本身而不是那个时代，它累积到三十年而没有上架。
decade 意为“十年”，指那座档案馆里每一个十年期，每一个末尾都有同一扇关着的门。
decade 意为“十年”，指留给照片专档的那一段，是唯一有人打开过两次的。
decade 意为“时代、年代”，指展览里断代的那一段时期，馆长说这个年代就是那场展览的全部。
decade 意为“时代”，指人人断代却无人定义的那一段而不是那十年本身，是展览里人人都断代、却无人定义的东西。
decade 意为“年代”，指导览手册上写到、被标明的那一段，到 1955 年这个年代成了手册里的一行。
decade 意为“十载、年代”，档案员四月写道，整件事的编年是一座档案馆和三十年的整理。
decade 意为“十年期”，我记得的是末尾那一段，1981 年编目，至今仍被说成全省最完整的一段。
decade 为抽象总称，助手 1983 年说，一个十年是唯一会因为被清点而变得更好的东西。
